# bizkit Provider

Manages one bizkit workspace's configuration with a workspace API key. The key's scopes decide which resources it can manage: most need `<area>:write`, and mailing lists need `mailing:admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bizkit = {
      source = "hay-kot/bizkit"
    }
  }
}

# Or set BIZKIT_ENDPOINT, BIZKIT_API_KEY and BIZKIT_WORKSPACE_ID.
provider "bizkit" {
  endpoint     = "https://bizkit.example.com"
  api_key      = var.bizkit_api_key
  workspace_id = "01a20560-0a68-7703-8e0c-5c2b8d9e8f01"
}

variable "bizkit_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A workspace API key (`bk_...`). Defaults to `BIZKIT_API_KEY`.
- `endpoint` (String) The bizkit base URL, such as `https://bizkit.example.com`. Defaults to `BIZKIT_ENDPOINT`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace the key belongs to. Defaults to `BIZKIT_WORKSPACE_ID`.
